_pipeline_lineage.title: Exploratory Data Analysis & Empirical Bayes CTR

upstream.inherited_features: All 24 raw schema columns verified with 0 missing values.
upstream.inherited_hypotheses: Click rate varies systematically by time-of-day, device connection type, and publisher placement.

mathematical_transition.theoretical_motivation: Raw categorical CTRs with small sample sizes exhibit extreme sample variance (e.g. 1 click on 1 impression = 100% CTR). Empirical Bayes shrinkage pulls noisy estimates toward the global prior mean Beta(alpha, beta).
mathematical_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(N + K) \text{ across } K \text{ distinct categorical levels}

downstream.hand_off_contract: Identified high-cardinality IDs (device_ip: 260k, site_id: 2.8k) and diurnal cycle (peak clicks 13:00-18:00 UTC) requiring cyclical harmonic encoding.

adtech_role.business_impact: Guides dynamic campaign pacing by identifying high-converting hours and isolates high-risk low-volume publisher domains to prevent budget drain.
